rationale: Both candidates are well-grounded and actionable, and both independently catch the numactl-flags, audio_reference-JSON, and RTX-PRO-5000-dangling-reference issues. But Y also substantively engages the two ground-truth threads X misses entirely: Ref2VA's untested/risky status (restart command incompatible with the documented download pattern, OOM risk on the 2-GPU profile) and the rigor of the validation numbers (self-contradicting 'floor' claim, unidentifiable two-variable fit, 1Hz undersampling of a 1.8s decode window). Y also catches a clean factual error X and even X's own report reproduce uncritically (GDDR7 mislabeled as HBM throughout) and a real usability bug (curl --max-time 1200 under a workload likely to exceed it). X's five findings are solid but are essentially a subset of Y's coverage.
